Name: Undertale Babies
Author: FreshSans
Description:
This mod replaces the babies with Frisk and Chara from Undertale. Frisk replaces African American babies, and Chara replaces the Caucasian babies. Only minor differences between the two genders with blue for boys and pink for girls.
I am looking to update this mod or make an entirely new mod to retexture other CHARActers into Undertale characters. This is my first retexture mod so please be gentle! (I also accept constructive criticism)
